items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Moe Gale was the first manager of the band... So Moe Gale was the one that gave me the notice.

ctx.x: The Savoy. See, Moe Gale was the first manager of the band. But the gangs...
That's the Savoy. They didn't have anything to do with the Cotton Club.
